classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Strong, hard to kill, improves at hitting things fastest. Little magic.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Sturdy healer and smiter. Decent in a fight, better with a prayer.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: Fragile, clumsy in melee, with the deepest well of mana and the loudest spells.
